description:
A credential of another service granted to a third-party plugin, named by the setting it
is held under and never by its value (`ARCH-R325`).

credential.description: The setting the credential is held under, as the inventory names it.

for.description: The capability of the plugin's own it was granted to fill.

of.description: The service whose credential it is.

plugin.description: The plugin it is granted to.
